description: List the fillable fields of a PDF form in reading order: name, readable label, type (text, checkbox, radio, dropdown, list, signature, button), page, current value, options, and whether it is required / read-only / multi-line. Use the names with pdf_form_fill. Web version: https://s3eidat.github.io/pdf-fill/

file.description: The PDF: a local file path (absolute, or relative to the server's --root) or base64 data (raw or a data: URI).

name: pdf_form_fields
title: List PDF form fields
